--- welcome

# Purpose

This survey contains 21 candidate items for an Artificial Intelligence (AI) adopter "type". The items were informed from a qualitative study [@callari2025meaningful]. At the end of the survey you will be provided a personalized report from the 21--item scale, however, the final validated measure will most likely consist of fewer items (your responses will help us refine the 21--items).

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = "matrix",
  id     = "ES1",
  label  = "Please indicate your agreement with the following statements.",
  row    = c(
    "I primarily use AI tools to complete routine or administrative tasks more efficiently" = "ES_1",
    "I reserve AI for tasks that demand little mental effort"          = "ES_2",
    "I prefer to keep final judgment and decision-making clearly in my own hands when using AI" = "ES_3"
    ),
  option = c(
    "Strongly Disagree" = "1",
    "Disagree"          = "2",
    "Neither Agree nor Disagree"  = "3",
    "Agree"            = "4",
    "Strongly Agree"   = "5"
  )
)
```

```{r}
sd_question(
  type   = "matrix",
  id     = "ES2",
  label  = "Please indicate your agreement with the following statements.",
  row    = c(
    "I am cautious about relying too heavily on AI-generated outputs" = "ES_4",
    "Using AI tools gives me more time to connect with colleagues" = "ES_5",
    "I am confident in my ability to construct useful AI prompts" = "ES_6"
  ),
  option = c(
    "Strongly Disagree" = "1",
    "Disagree"          = "2",
    "Neither Agree nor Disagree"  = "3",
    "Agree"            = "4",
    "Strongly Agree"   = "5"
  )
)
```

--- page2

Demographics will help us develop norms (comparative distributions against which future assessment takers' scores can be evaluated).




```{r}
sd_question(
  type  = "text",
  id    = "feedback",
  label = "Any feedback you'd like to provide the assessment developers:"
)
```

## End

This is the last page in the survey.

Here we call `sd_close()` to create a finish button to end the survey. When calling `sd_close()`, the auto-navigation is disabled.

:::

```{r}
sd_close()
```
